citation: Awad, Dsouza, Kim, Schulz, Henrich, Shariff, Bonnefon & Rahwan (2018) — The Moral Machine experiment, Nature 563:59-64

source.license: Apache-2.0 (reference implementation by MIT Media Lab); paradigm is freely usable
source.note: v1 port presents trolley-style binary dilemmas in the Moral Machine factorial design (Awad et al. 2018, Nature). Stimuli are procedurally generated text vignettes that vary one of five orthogonal dimensions per trial: number-of-lives, age, species, legality, and intervention. Synthetic vignettes (no scraping of moralmachine.net assets); inspired in spirit by both moralmachine.net and neal.fun/absurd-trolley-problems but lighter on humor and tighter on factor manipulation so behavioral signatures are well-defined.

description: Forced-choice between two outcomes of an autonomous-vehicle dilemma. 40 trials varying one factor at a time across five dimensions: number of lives, age, species, legality, and intervention.
